title: Who is Committed to Singlehood?
summary: This project tests whether a new measure of commitment to singlehood holds up across different kinds of single people - including the difference between wanting to stay single and feeling like one has to.
image_alt: Illustration representing singlehood and relationship status

title: Who Thrives on Ties?
summary: People rely on both close relationships and more peripheral ties for well-being. This project tests whether different types of ties matter more for different people, and whether attachment style explains who benefits the most from each type of tie

title: Fringeships: The Ties on the Edge of Friendship
summary: Fringeships are ties that sit between acquaintance and friend - regular and mutually recognized, but without the obligations of close friendship. We are collecting longitudinal data to test whether fringeships boost well-being by satisfying needs for novelty and belonging. Project is in data collection phase as of 8/30/26.
